caption: The drawing displays a single, detailed, green high-heeled boot that extends above the ankle, with a decorative yellow trim running along the top edge, down the front, and around the toe; the yellow trim features a looped or braided pattern. Two small, less detailed outlines of shoes, drawn in pencil with no color, are present in the upper left portion of the image—one seen from the side and the other from above. The background is plain and beige, with no additional objects or scenery.
title: Woman's Shoe
